```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
wp <- st_read("wr_417_dixon_reservoir.geojson")
```

```{r}
wp <- wp %>%
  mutate(
    transect = str_extract(title, "^T\\d+"),
    point    = str_extract(title, "(?<=_)\\d+")
  ) %>%
  select(title, transect, point, elevation, geometry)

print(wp)
```

```{r}
ggplot(wp) +
  geom_sf(aes(color = transect), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "T1" = "deepskyblue3",
    "T2" = "forestgreen",
    "T3" = "orange"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "WR 417 Dillon Dam - Sampling Waypoints",
    color = "Transect"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(leaflet)

pal <- colorFactor(palette = c("deepskyblue3", "forestgreen", "orange"), 
                   domain = c("T1", "T2", "T3"))

leaflet(wp) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Esri") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$USGS.USImageryTopo, group = "USGS") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    color = ~pal(transect),
    radius = 6,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~paste0(title, " — ", elevation, " m")
  ) %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~transect, title = "Transect")
```
